title.zh-CN: 在 GitHub 创建 OAuth App

body.zh-CN:
1. 打开下方官方申请页，新建 OAuth App。
2. Application name 填便于识别的名称，Homepage URL 填站点 APP_URL。
3. 将本页上方的回调 URL 原样填入 Authorization callback URL，然后注册应用。
4. 在 GitHub 应用页生成 Client Secret，将 Client ID 和 Client Secret 填入下方并保存。
5. 返回「登录方式」运行探测，再按需开启登录、注册和账号绑定。插件启用本身不会公开登录按钮。

Client Secret 仅保存在 SecretStore，留空会保留已保存的密钥。
body.en-US:
1. Open the official application page below and create an OAuth App.
2. Use a recognizable Application name and set Homepage URL to the site's APP_URL.
3. Paste the callback URL shown above exactly into Authorization callback URL, then register the app.
4. Generate a Client Secret in GitHub, enter the Client ID and Client Secret below, and save.
5. Return to Login methods, run the probe, then enable login, registration, and account linking as needed. Enabling the plugin alone does not expose a login button.

Client Secret is stored only in SecretStore; leaving it blank preserves the saved secret.
